evidence: Paths named by the brief exist and are staged. task/instruction.md:3 names '/instructions' ('the six notes') and '/assets/seed_data.json'; environment/instructions/ holds exactly six notes (behaviour, integration, overview, policy, security, ui) and environment/assets/ holds only seed_data.json. environment/Dockerfile:14-16 has 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/', 'COPY assets/ /assets/' and 'chmod -R a+rX /instructions /assets', byte-identical in structure to the frozen template Dockerfile. task.toml:2 artifacts = ["/app", "/assets"] matches the staged contract (staged-task-contract.md:38). Note-to-note references also resolve: integration.md:5 cites security.md and policy.md:3 cites ui.md, both present. Content agrees with every consumer. The seed parses as JSON: {"snippets": [], "note": "No saved snippets are supplied in this seed. Build a JavaScript and HTML playground with durable revision history."}; it is no longer the template placeholder "CHANGE_ME". instruction.md:3 says it 'describes the starting scope; there is no starter app to finish' and integration.md:7 says it 'contains no user snippets or starter implementation' - both true of the file. The golden does not read /assets at all (no seed/asset reference in solution/solve.sh or solution/app/server.js; server.js:147 only creates an empty snippets table), so its initial library is empty, matching snippets: []. No judge assumes seeded records: grep of app_context.md, both gate prompts and all three scored prompts/judge.toml files finds no seeded title, id or count, and tests/app_context.md:23 states 'the library may already hold records from earlier checks. Do not assume an empty library'. tests/test.sh:88 only chmods /assets and never reads it. Adversarial check: a submission that ignores /assets entirely loses nothing (correct, since the seed carries no data), and a conforming app that imports the empty snippets array also yields an empty library and is not penalised; no criterion can be pre-satisfied or broken by seed content. Limitation: this is a source-level reading; no run on these exact bytes logged the presence of /assets/seed_data.json inside the built agent image (the scripted golden ran in the agent image but does not touch /assets, and the hosted run was on an earlier candidate). The mechanical half belongs to check-assets-referenced.py and check-fixtures.py in the deterministic review. The imperative sentence inside the seed 'note' field belongs to row 14, not this row.
